# Backpackers Review

> > Detailed backpacking trip reports and trail guides for wilderness areas across North America, featuring multi-day treks through national parks like Yosemite, Grand Canyon, and Olympic.

Backpackers Review is authored by John Strother and provides comprehensive trip reports for challenging wilderness backpacking routes, including permit information, trail conditions, and detailed route descriptions. The site covers iconic destinations from the Cascade Mountains to the Canadian Rockies, with practical gear reviews to support backcountry adventures.

## Key Topics

- Multi-day backpacking
- Wilderness permits
- Yosemite National Park
- Grand Canyon National Park
- Alpine Lakes Wilderness
- Cascade Mountains
- Canadian Rockies
- Point-to-point treks
- Loop trails
- Backcountry camping
- National park hiking
- recreation.gov permits
- Trail conditions
- Backpacking gear reviews

## Featured Multi-Day Backpacking Routes

- [The Enchantments Traverse – Alpine Lakes Wilderness (18 mile point-to-point)](https://backpackers-review.com/trip-reports/the-enchantments-backpacking): 18-mile Enchantments Traverse through Alpine Lakes Wilderness
- [Four Pass Loop – Maroon Bells Snowmass Wilderness, CO (28 mile loop)](https://backpackers-review.com/trip-reports/four-pass-loop-maroon-bells): 28-mile Four Pass Loop in Maroon Bells-Snowmass Wilderness, Colorado
- [Salkantay Trek to Machu Picchu – 5 Day (46 mile)](https://backpackers-review.com/trip-reports/machu-picchu-salkantay-trek): 46-mile, 5-day Salkantay Trek from Cusco to Machu Picchu
- [Benson Lake Loop – Yosemite National Park (48 mile loop)](https://backpackers-review.com/trip-reports/benson-lake-yosemite): 48-mile Benson Lake loop through northern Yosemite with sand beach
- [The Escalante Route – Grand Canyon National Park (32 mile trek)](https://backpackers-review.com/trip-reports/the-escalante-route-grand-canyon): 32-mile Escalante Route trek along Colorado River in Grand Canyon

## Pacific Northwest & Cascade Trails

- [Spider Gap, Buck Creek Pass – Glacier Peak Wilderness (40 mile loop)](https://backpackers-review.com/trip-reports/spider-gap-buck-creek-pass-loop): 40-mile Spider Gap-Buck Creek Pass loop in Glacier Peak Wilderness
- [Grand Loop – Olympic National Park (43 mile loop)](https://backpackers-review.com/trip-reports/deer-park-olympic-national-park): 43-mile Grand Loop traversing four passes in Olympic National Park
- [Loowit Trail – Mount St. Helens National Volcanic Monument (30 mile loop)](https://backpackers-review.com/trip-reports/loowit-trail-mount-st-helens): 30-mile Loowit Trail loop around Mount St. Helens volcanic terrain
- [Broken Top Loop – Three Sisters Wilderness (24 mile loop)](https://backpackers-review.com/trip-reports/three-sisters-broken-top-loop): 24-mile Broken Top Loop with views of Three Sisters peaks in Oregon

## Yosemite & Sierra Nevada Routes

- [Grand Canyon of the Tuolumne River – Yosemite National Park (33 mile point-to-point)](https://backpackers-review.com/trip-reports/grand-canyon-tuolumne-yosemite): 33-mile Grand Canyon of Tuolumne trek through Yosemite's deep canyon
- [Lake Aloha via Rockbound Pass – Desolation Wilderness (38 mile loop)](https://backpackers-review.com/trip-reports/lake-aloha-desolation-wilderness): 38-mile loop to Lake Aloha via Rockbound Pass in Desolation Wilderness

## Canadian Rockies Adventures

- [Skyline Trail – Jasper National Park (28 mile point-to-point)](https://backpackers-review.com/trip-reports/skyline-trail-jasper): 28-mile Skyline Trail traverse through Jasper's Maligne Range
- [Iceline Trail and Takakkaw Falls – Yoho National Park (13 mile loop)](https://backpackers-review.com/trip-reports/yoho-iceline-trail): 13-mile Iceline Trail loop with Takakkaw Falls in Yoho National Park

## International & Unique Destinations

- [Saudi Arabia Trip – Mada'in Saleh, Al-'Ula, Elephant Rock, KAUST](https://backpackers-review.com/trip-reports/saudi-arabia-madain-saleh-al-ula-kaust): Saudi Arabia trip to UNESCO site Mada'in Saleh and KAUST
- [Aeolian Islands Hiking (Italy)](https://backpackers-review.com/trip-reports/aeolian-islands-hiking): Hiking volcanic Aeolian Islands including Salina and Stromboli
